text:
Maria: Quick sync — vendor roadmap surfaced a few blocking items for marketplace + SI onramp. NVIDIA bumped an H200 tranche ~2w, MI300 still fuzzy, Gaudi asking for a firmware embargo. Need to align listing windows, staging images, and press cadence. cc @Kevin @Jess :eyes:
Kevin: saw it. I'll pull perf deltas and image diffs. Question — do we force a quantized fallback for H200 wave or keep float32 options?
Jess: SI lead says they need k8s node images + kernel 6.2 support by next Wed. Can we hand them a staging tag?
Cheng: lab inventory update — we have 25 H100 cards landing Wed. B200 shipment just slipped to late May. We can repurpose some H100 capacity for early QA if that helps.
Nathan: marketing note — we can tentatively hold soft press windows, but can't lock until embargo dates are firm. Recommend 'announce-if-ready' approach.
vendor-feed-bot: Vendor update: NVIDIA H200 ETA revised 2026-05-02 -> 2026-05-16. MI300: no change. Gaudi (Habana) requests firmware embargo 2026-05-10 -> 2026-05-17.
Maria: ok, let's has a short runbook. Please react :thumbsup: if this is doable or flag blockers. Draft runbook below:
```
Runbook draft:
- Marketplace: keep "available"=false for affected SKU families until embargo lifted.
- Marketplace: publish compatible-skus file v1.2 on 2026-05-18 (includes H100/H200/B200/MI300/Gaudi tags).
- Images: deliver k8s node image tag: rgw-hw-staging:gaudi-20260505 (for SI testing).
- SI: integration test harness + perf report due by 2026-05-20.
- Lab: allocate 10 H100s for SI smoke next Fri.
- Press: soft-window 2026-05-21 -> 2026-05-28; marketing to confirm final date after 5/18 signoff.
```
Jess: prefer image name `redwood-node:hw-staging-gaudi` — matches our CD naming.
Kevin: noted. I'll queue the image build and toggle the staging tag. ETA Tue.
Cheng: can do the 10 H100s for SI smoke next Fri, but need kernel + driver pins from platform. Will open a ticket.
Maria: I opened ticket PLAT-4921 for kernel/drivers pinning and compatibility matrix entry. @Nathan we'll need a comms hold until 2026-05-18 signoff.
Nathan: ack. prepping comms kit but won't schedule press until final signoff.
Maria: action items: (1) Kevin build + tag image, (2) Cheng reserve H100s + attach driver pin ticket, (3) Jess coordinate SI deliverables + test harness, (4) Nathan hold comms. Please reply with :thumbsup: or call out blockers.
Kevin: :thumbsup:
Jess: :thumbsup:
Cheng: :thumbsup: opening infra ticket now.
Nathan: will stand by.
Maria: thanks everyone — we'll reconvene if vendor dates shift again.
